repo: signIpnsRecord in tee-worker/src/services/ipns-signer.ts was dead code after this phase replaced it with renewIpnsRecord — only self-referencing, safe to delete.
enrollFolder was collapsed from 3-arg to 2-arg in Phase 67; the tee-republish SDK E2E suite directly exercises this enrollment path.

tee_key_state is empty at API start and repopulates automatically when the worker is healthy and the shared secret matches — no manual seed needed.

NaN is not caught by !Number.isFinite in TypeScript — isNaN() must be added separately to guard numeric epoch fields.

code.finding: signIpnsRecord (old CID-originating primitive) was dead code post-phase and removed along with its orphaned JSDoc that had been left above renewIpnsRecord.
Missing NaN guard on epoch: !Number.isFinite alone passes NaN; added isNaN() check.
Epoch validation accepted non-integers and negatives; tightened to reject non-integer and negative values, not just non-finite.
beforeAll lacked a migration guard; added information_schema column-drop assertion so CI cannot green against an un-migrated schema.
Added two new tests for NaN epoch guard (NaN input and malformed string anchor) — suite grew from 74 to 76 passing.

workflow: git commit with 1Password SSH signing reports a false-negative timeout (exit non-zero) while the commit actually lands — always verify with 'git log --oneline -1' before retrying or amending.
Kill and restart the API from a fresh dist with explicit env vars before SDK E2E runs; a pre-existing API process may have stale env or pre-rebuild binaries.
Run targeted test suites (pnpm --filter <pkg> test) rather than full monorepo runs to avoid RAM exhaustion — confirmed by prior project feedback.
CodeRabbit CLI --agent review takes several minutes on large diffs; background it with Bash run_in_background and wait for the task-notification rather than polling.

Triage CodeRabbit findings using the operating rule: fix if in-scope + low-risk; write a dated todo under .planning/todos/pending/ for pre-existing, design-nuanced, or risky items; skip confirmed false positives.

GSD security auditor's ASVS L1 + register_authored_at_plan_time:true + threats_open:0 would normally short-circuit to Step 6, but the phase touched CRITICAL security paths — spawning the auditor anyway provides meaningful defense depth.
Commit subjects were already conventional (type(67-NN): style) so the filter-branch reword step was a no-op — check before running it.

friction: 1Password SSH signing causes git commit to hang and exit non-zero, appearing as a failure while the commit actually lands — creates ambiguity and requires a verification step after every commit.
API on :3000 left running from a prior session with unknown/stale env — had to kill and restart fresh before E2E to avoid false passes.
CodeRabbit CLI review took several minutes with no incremental output, requiring backgrounding; intermediate progress checks showed only that processes were alive, not how far along.
GSD validate-phase enforcement hook was inactive, creating a divergence between the GSD gate contract and the ship-phase requirement — had to proceed outside the normal hook-guarded flow.
gh pr edit is broken on this repo (Projects-classic GraphQL) — PR body must be patched via 'gh api -X PATCH' with a temp file, adding an extra step.
